subject: general
question:
John, Kelly, Lisa, Mike, Nancy, and Owen-are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only one person sits to the left of Kelly. Exactly two people sit between Kelly and Lisa. Mike sits second to the right of Owen. Mike is not an immediate neighbor of Lisa. John sits to the immediate right of Lisa.

Who sits at the extreme left end of the line?
solution:
**Given: **John, Kelly, Lisa, Mike, Nancy, and Owen-are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

Only one person sits to the left of Kelly. Exactly two people sit between Kelly and Lisa. John sits to the immediate right of Lisa.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/871f3c3501b2c0ea90d319c006c0b24d38b689b7ca337b965798565f21b4bad9.png] 

Mike sits second to the right of Owen. Mike is not an immediate neighbor of Lisa.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f742eaa009613a18a25752227acd044cff4d9cf31a65ff3e711eb02646a000d.png] 

Final arrangement,

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/653919038cdcb82d28336adc95666997db2ad08296e5381348d57c5a9f3644c8.png] 

Thus. Owen is sitting extreme left end of the line.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
